reasoning_summary: The ODE integrator fails to terminate exactly at the requested end time when the step size calculation results in a value very close to zero due to floating-point precision limitations. The fix introduces an explicit handling for this 'near-zero' step case by forcing the interpolator to store the current state and setting the step size to zero, ensuring the integration loop terminates correctly at the target time rather than overshooting it.
